body:
I don't want life,if it means this.\
If the only thing I hold is knife\
and all I want is cut my wrist.\
\
I don't want life to be so dark\
and my mind to be filled with sorrows,\
Can somebody please send an ark,\
so I can hope for nice tomorrows?

To exist – so easy it might seem,\
but for me it's not, I suffer, cry.\
Wish it to be just a dream,\
so it can end in blink of eye.\
Can somebody please tell my mind,\
that silly, haunted house of mine,\
"Life can be good, don't be so blind!\
It can send shivers down your spine!"

But I am tired, my answer is.\
I don't want this, or that, don't you see?\
I no longer believe in this,\
so let me please leave to be free.
perex: I don't want life,if it means this.
